entries.def:
ἀριστερός, -ά, -όν 
[in LXX for שְׂמֹאול ;] 
left, on the left: ὅπλα, 2Co.6.7 ἡ ἀ.. (sc. χείρ), Mat.6.3 ἐξ ἀριστερῶν, on the left (MM, see word ): Mrk.10.37, Luk.23.33.†
(AS)

Ἀριστόβουλος, -ου, ὁ
(ἄριστος, βουλή, i.e. best-counselling) 
Aristobulus, a Christian: Rom.16.10.†
(AS)

ἄριστον, -ου, τό 
[in LXX: 1Ki.3.1 (לֶחֶם), Tob.2.1, 4, al. ;] 
__1 1, prop., breakfast. 
__2. In late Gk. = cl. δεῖτνον, dinner: Mat.22.4, Luk.11.38; 14.12.†
(AS)

ἀρκετός, -ή, -όν
(ἀρκέω), [in Aq.: Deu.25.2 * ;] 
sufficient: Mat.6.34 (on the neut., see B1., § 31, 2); before ἵνα (M, Pr., 210), Mat.10.25 with inf., 1Pe.4.3 (for exx., see Deiss., BS, 257; MM, see word).†
(AS)

ἀρκέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX for הוֹן, etc. ;] 
__1. to keep off; with dative, to assist. 
__2. to suffice: with dative of person(s), Jo 67, 2Co.12.9 impers., Mat.25.9, Jhn.14.8 (MM, see word). Pass., to be satisfied: with dative of thing(s), Luk.3.14, 1Ti.6.8, Heb.13.5; before ἐπί, 3Jn.10.†
(AS)

ἅρκος
(Rec. (cl.) ἅρκιος), [in LXX for דֹּב ;] -ου, ὁ, ἡ, 
a bear: Rev.13.2. (This form is also found in late Inscr.; MM, see word)†
(AS)

ἅρμα, -τος, τό
(ἀραρίσκω, to join), [in LXX רָכַב ;] 
a chariot: Act.8.28-29, 38, Rev.9.9.†
(AS)

Ἁρμαγεδών (WH, Ἃρ Μαγεδών; Rec. Ἀρμαγεδδών, prop. = הַר מְגִדּוֹן), cf. LXX, Μαγεδών, 2Ch.35.22, Μαγεδώ, Jdg.1.27 Har-Magedon (AV, Armageddon): Rev.16.16 (see Swete, in l, but also Thayer, see word).†
Ἅρ, 
indecl., Rev.16.16, see, Ἁρμαγεδών 
Μαγεδών, 
Magedon: Rev.16.16 (WH, Ἅρ M. for Ἁρμαγεδών, which see).†
(AS)

ἁρμόζω
(ἁρμός), [in LXX for אמן, etc. ;] 
__1. to fit, join. 
__2. of marriage, to betroth. Mid., 
__(a) to join to oneself, marry, take to wife; (b) to give in marriage: 2Co.11.2 (for this there is no direct parallel. But see M, Pr., 160; MM, see word).†
(AS)

ἁρμός, -ου, ὁ 
[in LXX: Sir.27.2, 4Ma.10.5 * ;] 
a joining, joint: Heb.4.12.†
(AS)
